program.title: BBA in Operations Management
uncertain: total_required_credits is a calculated value: the PDF does not state a fixed total for the major; it is the sum of the required_credits of all groups.

The OM Electives group is 'Any 4 ISOM courses coded between 3500 and 3999 (except ISOM 3780) and 4500 to 4999' for students without an option; the course list recorded in the JSON is the restricted list printed in the PDF for students taking the Business Analytics option.

Both options (Business Analytics, Supply Chain Management) are optional ('Students may opt to graduate with or without an option'); the option required credits (12 in total) are included in the calculated total, but a student graduating without an option would not take them.
The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 OM (4Y) (2023-24 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2023-24 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2023-24 per the intake year.
